description: This file implements the TalkModeRuntime actor, which manages speech recognition, text-to-speech playback, and voice interaction logic for a macOS app. It handles lifecycle management, audio input handling, speech recognition tasks, TTS integration (including ElevenLabs and system voices), and configuration reloading from a remote gateway. The code features complex state management, asynchronous operations, and external service integrations for voice and speech functionalities.

classes.name: RMSMeter
classes.description: A thread-safe class that tracks the latest RMS audio level, used for noise detection and volume monitoring during speech input.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Asynchronously enables or disables the speech recognition and processing.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Pauses or resumes recognition, manages phase state, and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Sets up and initiates the speech recognition task and audio input tap.

methods.name: stopRecognition
methods.description: Cancels ongoing recognition tasks and cleans up audio input.

methods.name: handleRecognition
methods.description: Processes recognition results, updates state, handles speech interruptions, and manages transitions.

methods.name: startSilenceMonitor
methods.description: Begins a periodic check to detect silence and finalize speech input.

methods.name: checkSilence
methods.description: Checks if sufficient silence has occurred to consider speech input as finalized.

methods.name: finalizeTranscript
methods.description: Resets transcript state and proceeds to send the recognized text for processing.

methods.name: sendAndSpeak
methods.description: Sends the recognized text to the gateway, awaits assistant response, and plays the assistant's reply via TTS.
